paragraphs.text: Primo is a legendary fractal wolf created by Zimone Wola that only appears in prime numbers.

Primo is Zimone's trusty companion fractal. He has the appearance of a wolf comprised of blue fractals with a magic circle carved into the fractals of its left hip. Zimone initially summoned Primo simply because she enjoyed his wolflike form, but after returning from Duskmourn , she found herself unwilling to unsummon him. As Primo continued to observe and interact with the world, he picked up his own personality traits, taking his role as Zimone's friend and stalwart defender very seriously.
